title: No Claim on File

Is the policy active on the DOS?
What is the timely filing limit?
May I have claim mailing address, Payer ID, and Fax#?
Can we fax or mail the claim along with POTF?
May I get the call reference number?

Confirm TFL and gather POTF if past TFL
Resubmit, fax, or release to patient per findings

title: Claim in Process

Is the claim still within TAT?
What is the reason for delay?
What documents or information are requested?
May I have the claim# and call ref#?

If within TAT, set follow-up for remaining days
If delayed for provider docs, send or task client

Document expected payment timeframe
Set follow-up for expected release date

May I have the claim# and call ref#?
